mass_spec.basis: Inference: conservative engineering mass allowances, except J430 socket maker mass 0.434 g (Molex 472192001 product record). The J430 mated card allowance 0.5 g is an inference. DB125 terminal body allowances scale the existing 3 g two-contact allowance by pole count: 3 g two-contact, 6 g four-contact, 7.5 g five-contact. Terminal keys ending in 'mated' are separate local wire/ferrule allowances, not mating plugs: 1 g per two contacts, 2 g per four, 2.5 g per five. Validate by weighing the actual populated board and supported harness. Connector/capacitor dimensions: parts_qualification.md; DB125 drawing T0-1; MA drawing p2. No inherited R9 RF, SMA, GH or servo-plug masses.
mass_spec.placement: tools/plate_model.py --profile r10 places every key: on its own fit-report row's model box, or, for 'X mated' with no row of its own (DB125 terminals' local wire/ferrule allowance, no mated plug envelope in fit_check), on its parent X's model box; any other key is refused (R3-MEC-01)

removed_bench_only.J2: TC2030 Tag-Connect: a bare land (fit_check board feature), no body on the board
removed_bench_only.J2 mated: the TC2030 cable is a bench programming tool, never fitted in flight
removed_bench_only.J3 mated: the USB-C plug is a bench / ground tool, never fitted in flight (J3's body mass stays)

mass_spec.harness_rule: Strain relief carries cable mass beyond the modelled plug/local-wire envelope; unrestrained long leads invalidate these allowances.

calculation_basis: Simulation/Inference: existing explicit connector masses include metal pins;23 fit collision-tail boxes are not additional assembled parts and are excluded from plate mass. No measured mass,stiffness,sled or boundary condition.

local_sled_clearance.method: 0.25mm raster including exact envelope endpoints; rigid sled; absolute100g/pinnedD5 deflection
